artboards.title: C · Home stack insight + unlock sheet

annotations.text:
CONCEPT A — the stack as the mental model.
Foundation at the bottom, goal at the top, one highlighted 'next unlock'. Teaches WHY order matters (generic services first = legal strategy).

Best teacher; biggest build (new Journey-tab top level).

CONCEPT B — SDP steps 0–8, current per the Mar 2026 DDS directive (D-2026-SDP-002): two-part SCDD-only orientation, certificate hand-off with the 4 mandatory items.

Exactly one CTA, on the current step, wired to a letter + tracked clock. Slots into the existing ProcessMap SDP fork — least navigation change.

CONCEPT C — Home insight + Undivided-style unlock sheet (WHAT / WHY / HOW + parent tip).
Mini stack bars tease the model; the sheet converts it into one drafted request.

Smallest build, highest reach — recommended first ship together with B.

Shared rules across all three:
· every claim carries a citation + reviewed date
· one primary CTA per screen, always ending in a letter or tracked clock
· trilingual EN/ES/VI via the L() pattern
· values framed honestly (no invented dollar averages)

Plan: Roadmap/Resource-Stack-Journey-Plan.md
